resale_co.name: Certificate of Conformity for Resale / Change of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: Bordentown Township Construction Department (inspection by the fire district serving the block)
resale_co.lead_time: Request at least 10 business days before the change in ownership or occupancy
requirements: Smoke detectors on all floors (Township Code 274-5); battery units must be 10-year sealed
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of sleeping areas (UL 2034) if there is a fuel-burning appliance or attached garage
Portable fire extinguisher, 2A:10BC residential, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen (form still lists it)
House numbers in Arabic numerals, at least 3 inches, on the front wall or porch and visible from the street (Township Code 200-7)
Open construction permits and violations must be closed first

fees.label: Single family home, townhouse, duplex, or apartment in a single family home
fees.quote: Single Family Homes/Townhouses/Duplexes/Apartments in Single Family Homes: $100.00

fees.label: House resale re-inspection
fees.quote: House Resale / Rental Inspection Fee: $100.00 Re-Inspection Fee: $65.00

fees.label: Apartment re-inspection
fees.quote: Apartment Rental/Change in Tenancy Fee: $80.00 Re-Inspection Fee: $55.00

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out page 2 (Request for Certificate of Conformity) of the fillable form, check the fire district for the property's block, and return it to the Bordentown Township Construction Department, 1 Municipal Drive, with exact cash or a check payable to Bordentown Township. The fire district then calls the contact person to schedule; the homeowner, realtor or maintenance staff must be present.
resale_co.contact_title: Technical Assistant to the Construction Official

evidence.quote: Inspection requests must be made at least TEN (10) BUSINESS DAYS prior to the change in ownership or occupancy of the dwelling.
Please complete page 2 and return it to the Bordentown Township Construction Department with the appropriate application fee.
Open Construction Permits and Violations must be closed before a Certificate of Conformity will be issued.
Certificates of Conformity are valid for 60 days
Certificate of Conformity for Resale/Change of Occupancy (Fillable Form).pdf
Resale Housing / Change of Occupancy / Change of Commercial Tenancy
Reyan Frank ... Technical Assistant to the Construction Official ... r.frank@bordentowntownship.org ... (609)298-2800,2121

resale_co.notes: The township website (bordentowntownship.com) shows a browser challenge page. The form was found through the site's own document listing service (thrillshare-cmsv2.services.thrillshare.com), which lists it in the Construction > Resale Housing / Change of Occupancy / Change of Commercial Tenancy folder, and downloaded from the township's document host. The certificate is a fire safety inspection only (smoke, CO, extinguisher, house numbers); the form says a fuller building inspection is up to the buyer's private inspector. Pay by exact cash or check to Bordentown Township.

requirements: All battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units; alarms on each level and outside each sleeping area; alarms need not be interconnected; hardwired alarms from original construction cannot be replaced with battery units
Smoke/CO combination units are acceptable but must have the 10-year sealed battery

Fire extinguisher at least 2A:10BC, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen, top no higher than 60 inches, on the maker's bracket, near an exit path, with the owner's manual; proof of purchase accepted instead of a service tag (form created March 2024 still lists it)
House numbers at least 3 inches, Arabic numerals, contrasting and visible from the street

evidence.quote: Chief of Department Robert MacFarland - r.macfarland@btfd2.org
Bordentown Twp Fire Dist #2 Phone (609) 298-8527 Email r.macfarland@btfd2.org

fire_cert.notes: Which district inspects depends on the property's tax block: District #1 (Mission) for Blocks 1 through 61, District #2 (Derby) for Block 62 and up. The fee is paid once to Bordentown Township with the Certificate of Conformity application; no separate fire district smoke certificate fee was found. The state LEA registry says District #1 is the fire code enforcing agency for District #2's area (and for Bordentown City), and the DCA directory lists Fire Official Mark Mezger (mmezger@missionfire.org) for both township district pages. The form gives only 'Capt. Scully' for District #2 (no first name). The Mission Fire page lists Mark Mezger at extension 503; the form's scheduling line is extension 105. The form (created March 2024) still requires a fire extinguisher although P.L.2025, c.19 (February 3, 2025) removed it from the state rule.

other_items.detail: Open construction permits and violations must be closed before the Certificate of Conformity is issued.
